messages:
jamie: Heads up — planning a rolling maintenance this Saturday 02:00-05:00 UTC for k8s node upgrades in eu-west-1. Affects dedicated inference pools and can cause short routing shifts. Please review the plan below and call out any objections by EOD today.

ria: @jamie noted. Do we expect any SLO impact for 99th pct tail?

jamie: Short answer: small blips during cordon/drain on node groups. We'll be using canary drain + traffic steering to other regions to keep steady-state request success, but p99 latency may spike up to ~250ms for a few minutes per step. SLO doc updated here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-adjustments/2026-03-k8s-maint.md

tom: Which clusters exactly? I want to schedule the on-call overlap.

jamie: eu-west-1-prod-01/02 (dedicated pools) and eu-west-1-hosted-edge. Steps: 1) cordon node, 2) drain with --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data, 3) upgrade kernel, 4) uncordon. We run 1 node at a time.

oncall-sre: Added to my calendar. I'll be on-call for 02:00-06:00 UTC and will escalate to infra if anything weird.

ria: We should add a temporary SLO policy relax for that window so alerts don't page. Can infra/alerting add a suppression? (@oncall-sre can you confirm?)

oncall-sre: I'll open a suppression for the following alerts: latency-p99-eu-west, request-error-rate-eu-west. Duration 4h starting 02:00 UTC. Will keep a heartbeat monitor on.

jamie: deploy-bot: Planned maintenance window registered. Incident channel: #temp-alerts. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/k8s-node-upgrade-playbook.md

deploy-bot: Reminder: please annotate any post-maint issues with tags [maint-eu-west-2026-03] and add perf traces to the incident ticket.

tom: Quick question about routing — are we proactively shifting capacity to us-east to reduce p99, or relying on autoscale?

jamie: We'll do a small pre-warm in us-east: scale dedicated pools +20% 30m before start, then traffic steering policy will prefer us-east for latency-sensitive routes. Autoscale remains enabled.

ria: I ran a quick simulation against the staging routing policy and saw a ~5% increase in token cost when steering to us-east. We'll capture cost delta in postmortem.

oncall-sre: Logged a firebreak plan: if p99 > 350ms for >10m AND error-rate >1% then rollback traffic steering and pause node upgrades.

jamie: Good. Also reminder: please avoid manual redeploys of model services during the window unless absolutely necessary. That has caused flaky redis connections in the past.

tom: I've updated the status page draft and will publish 30m before start. Draft link: https://redwood.internal/status/drafts/eu-west-maint-2026-03.md

ria: One last callout — customers with Dedicated contracts in eu-west may see capacity reduction. CS notified earlier today but we should ping them 1h before start. @jamie can you take that?

jamie: Yup I'll send the heads-up 1h prior.

oncall-sre: Ready. I'll post a short post-maint summary (inc expected vs observed p99, error spikes, cost delta) into #eng-sre and tag product and CS.

jamie: Thanks everyone. If no objections by 18:00 UTC I'll proceed to lock the window and run the upgrade runbook. :white_check_mark:

ria: lgtm :thumbsup:

tom: :+1:

deploy-bot: Maintenance window locked by jamie at 18:12 UTC. Good luck!
